newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC sees better performance in 1997.
newsitem.headline: IPC sees better performance in 1997.

text.p: Computer company IPC Corp Ltd said on Monday it expected to improve its performance in 1997, after turning in a net loss in 1996.
IPC said in a statement issued with its 1996 results it would focus in 1997 on strengthening its core businesses after completing a restructuring of its computer and related businesses.
It said it viewed its core businesses as the manufacture and sale of computer and telecommunications products.
"The directors are optimistic of the group's prospects for 1997. Barring unforeseen circumstances, the group is expected to improve its performance this year."

IPC made a net loss after extraordinaries of Singapore $23.9 million in 1996. The company reported an extraordinary loss of S$37.4 million due principally to a provision in respect of its Korean subsidiary.
